newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania to name new finance minister soon.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania to name new finance minister soon.

text.p: Lithuania will name a new finance minister during the course of this week after former minister Rolandas Matiliauskas quit over a bank loan scandal, Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Monday.
"We will decide on the new finance minister in a few days time," Vagnorius told journalists after meeting Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas.

During the meeting, Vagnorius presented the resignation of Matiliauskas, who quit late last month amid allegations that he took a soft loan from a bank where he used to work which later went bankrupt.
"I see no reason why the president should not accept this resignation," Vagnorious said.
The prosecutor's office said it found no wrongdoing over the loan, which was taken from Kredito Bankas.
But it said on Friday that it was investigating other charges linked to Matiliauskas' time as an employee of the bank.
"We haven't discussed a candidate with the president yet, but we want to evaluate possible candidates more carefully this time," he added.
Matiliauskas, 29, was the youngest minister in Vagnorius' right-of-centre government, which was swept to power during parliamentary elections last fall.
Lithuania needs to fill the post soon as it is currently looking for banks to lead a proposed $200 million eurobond issue in March.
